verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with partner credentials and an OAuth2 authorization-code flow for acting on behalf of users, so programmatic access exists. The evidence never states which operations the API covers, so parity with the UI is unevidenced. The 'Ask Expensify AI' natural-language features are in-product chat, not API access. Missing for 10: any documented list of API operations (expenses, reports, approvals, workspace/rules config, cards, invoices, travel), an explicit claim of UI/API parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
